remarks:
Welcome to 66 Vernon Place, a spacious North Buffalo duplex offering over 2,200 square feet, six total bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and an excellent opportunity for both investors and owner-occupants. Each unit features three bedrooms and one full bathroom with a functional and spacious layout. A covered front porch provides a welcoming entrance and additional outdoor space to enjoy. Inside, you’ll find original character throughout, including hardwood flooring and classic woodwork. The home also features a spacious attic offering plenty of additional potential for future use, along with a full basement providing even more storage.

Major improvements include a complete tear-off roof approximately 1.5 years ago, updated bathrooms, newer kitchen and bathroom windows, glass block basement windows, two newer hot water tanks, and electrical updates. Separate gas and electric meters along with two furnaces add to the functionality of the two-unit setup. Outside, the two-car garage provides valuable off-street parking along with additional space for storage, tools, lawn equipment, bikes, and more.

Located in North Buffalo/Parkside, 66 Vernon Place puts you close to many of the shops, restaurants, parks, entertainment, and everyday conveniences that make the area so desirable. Enjoy easy access to Hertel Avenue and Delaware Avenue, along with nearby parks and convenient access to Downtown Buffalo and surrounding areas. With six bedrooms, separate utilities, a covered front porch, spacious attic, full basement, two-car garage, and a convenient North Buffalo location, this property offers an abundance of space, flexibility, and potential.
